description: Retire a SANCTIONED memory when the person told you in this conversation to remove it and nothing replaces it. Archived, never deleted. With a corrected version, use arroway_remember supersedes_id; for your own pending proposal, arroway_withdraw.

decided_by_human.description: Must be true, and only when the person explicitly told you to remove it IN THIS CONVERSATION.

memory.description: The memory to retire — the #handle from a read is enough.

why.description: Optional: what the person said made it obsolete, in their terms.

name: arroway_retire
title: Retire a sanctioned memory, on the person's instruction
